body:
Source: GitHub issue #640 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 42cb00eb: packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/loop.mjs:111-135. In `runLoop`, when an adversary model returns unusable output (refusals, malformed text, invalid JSON), `parseCandidates` yields `candidates: []`. The loop destructures only `candidates` and discards `errors`. Zero candidates classified means `newDefeatsThisRound === 0`, advancing `dryStreak`. Three such rounds set `stoppedBy = 'dry'`, `exhaustive: true`, and the run exits 0 'clean' having classified zero candidates.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/gate-fuzzing`: `bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/loop.mjs` (runLoop, computeVerdict), `lib/candidate.mjs` (parseCandidates), `lib/classify.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/loop.mjs`: when a fan query produces zero parsed candidates (or fails schema validation), count it as an invalid candidate generation round; if all results in a round produce zero valid candidates, mark the round as inconclusive (`inconclusiveRounds++`) rather than advancing `dryStreak`.
2. In `packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/loop.mjs`: in `computeVerdict`, refuse to return `summary: 'clean'` or `exhaustive: true` if total candidates classified across the entire run is 0; return `summary: 'inconclusive'` and exit non-zero (exit 1 or 2) when no candidates were ever evaluated.
3. In JSON and human report, surface parse/validation rejection counts and ensure `candidatesGenerated` reflects actual usable candidates.
4. Documentation: update `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/gate-fuzzing.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A run where the model returns unusable output (e.g. refusals) is marked inconclusive rather than clean/exhaustive. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/unusable-candidates-inconclusive.test.mjs`
- AC2 Zero classified candidates across a run produces inconclusive verdict and non-zero exit. verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/unusable-candidates-inconclusive.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/gate-fuzzing`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "inconclusive" packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md docs/tools/gate-fuzzing.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/gate-fuzzing.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #642 (witnessSource) or #643 (path traversal in record).
title: gate-fuzzing: do not advance dryStreak on unusable model output and refuse clean on zero classified candidates
